title: ViT → CLIP → SigLIP, barebones in NumPy

paper.title: Sigmoid Loss for Language Image Pre-Training

summary: Three line-by-line NumPy implementations in one consistent style (no LN gains, no biases inside blocks, explicit weight arguments): a ViT forward pass; CLIP's two towers (ViT with ln_pre/ln_post, causal text transformer pooled at [EOS]) and its symmetric softmax contrastive loss; and SigLIP's towers (MAP attention-pool head with a learned probe, bidirectional last-token text) and its pairwise sigmoid loss with learnable temperature and bias. ViT and CLIP papers are in refs/.

problems.title: CLIP: both towers and the symmetric contrastive loss
SigLIP: MAP pooling, last-token text, sigmoid loss
